Class ArcOut

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.ArcOut
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class ArcOut extends Object implements Cloneable, Serializable
This class for creating the arc between transition and place of Petri net (and directed from transion to place)
Author:
Inna V. Stetsenko
